headline: Monetary Policy Committee raises Repo Rate by 25 bps to curb headline inflation and anchor expectations
RBI increases regulatory risk weights on bank and NBFC unsecured retail loans and credit cards by 25 percentage points
Union Budget enhances capital expenditure outlay for National Infrastructure Pipeline, highways and dedicated freight corridors
Cabinet approves expansion of Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme with 10000 crore outlay for auto components and electronics
Defence Acquisition Council approves 5th Positive Indigenisation List mandating domestic procurement for military equipment
Government imposes export duty and windfall tax adjustments on crude oil, diesel and overseas steel shipments
SEBI issues comprehensive disclosure circular on ESG ratings, insider trading regulations, and algorithmic trading safeguards
Ministry of Power notifies revised Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO) trajectory through 2030 to accelerate green transition
NPPA fixes revised ceiling price for 65 essential medicine formulations under National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM)
Ministry of Electronics and IT notifies rules under Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act for consent management
